setName: Speed Duel Starter Decks: Twisted Nightmares

Common.name: Allure of Darkness
Common.desc: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 DARK monster from your hand, or, if you do not have any in your hand, send your entire hand to the GY.

Common.name: Bowganian
Common.desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Brave Scizzar
Common.desc: Armed with a mass of scissors, this monster can clip an enemy into any desired shape and size.

Common.name: Byser Shock
Common.desc: If this card is Summoned: Return all Set cards on the field to the hand.

Common.name: Coffin Seller
Common.desc: Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Common Charity
Common.desc: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 Normal Monster from your hand, or, if you do not have any in your hand, send your entire hand to the GY.

Common.name: Creature Seizure
Common.desc: Each player gives their opponent control of 1 of their monsters (controller's choice). You must choose a face-up Normal Monster.

Common.name: Creeping Darkness
Common.desc: Banish 2 DARK monsters from your GY; add 1 Level 4 DARK monster from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Dark Eruption
Common.desc: Target 1 DARK monster with 1500 or less ATK in your GY; add that target to your hand.

Common.name: Dark Jeroid
Common.desc: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it loses 800 ATK.

Common.name: Dark Lucius LV4
Common.desc: Negate the effects of your opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with this card. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of your next turn after this card has destroyed a monster by battle: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV6" from your hand or Deck.

Common.name: Dark Lucius LV6
Common.desc: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV4", negate the effects of your opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with this card. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of your next turn after this card negated your opponent's monster effect by this effect: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Lucius LV8" from your hand or Deck.

Common.name: Dark Lucius LV8
Common.desc: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Lucius LV6", banish your opponent's monsters destroyed by battle with this card, also negate their effects.

Common.name: Dark Mimic LV1
Common.desc:
FLIP: Draw 1 card.
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Mimic LV3" from your hand or Deck.

Common.name: Dark Mimic LV3
Common.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Draw 1 card, but if this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Dark Mimic LV1", draw 2 cards instead.

Common.name: Dark Necrofear
Common.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 3 Fiend monsters from your GY. During the End Phase, if this card is in your GY because it was destroyed in your Monster Zone by an opponent's card and sent there this turn: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; equip this card to that target. While this card is equipped to a monster by this effect, take control of that monster.

Common.name: Dark Prisoner
Common.desc: This monster bends light to hide its image from the eyes of opponents.

Common.name: Dark Ruler Ha Des
Common.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. Negate the effects of monsters destroyed by battle with Fiend monsters you control.

Common.name: Dokuroyaiba
Common.desc: A boomerang with brains that will pursue a target to the ends of the earth.

Common.name: Drillago
Common.desc: If the only cards your opponent controls are face-up monsters with 1600 or more ATK, this card can attack your opponent directly.

Common.name: Earthbound Spirit
Common.desc: A vengeful creature formed by the spirits of fallen warriors, it drags any who dare approach it into the deepest bowels of the earth.

Common.name: Faustian Bargain
Common.desc: Target 1 Special Summoned monster on either field; send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand.

Common.name: Gaap the Divine Soldier
Common.desc: All monsters are changed to Attack Position, also their battle positions cannot be changed. (Flip Effects are not activated.) Once per turn: You can reveal any number of Fiend monsters in your hand; this card gains 300 ATK for each, until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Gil Garth
Common.desc: This steel-armored terror machine ruthlessly strikes down enemies with its giant katana.

Common.name: Headless Knight
Common.desc: A haunted spirit of a falsely accused knight who wanders in search of truth and justice.

Common.name: Helpoemer
Common.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned from the GY. At the end of your opponent's Battle Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle: Make your opponent discard 1 random card. This card must be in the GY to activate and to resolve this effect.

Common.name: Inner Conflict
Common.desc:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can pay half your LP and take control of 1 monster your opponent controls until the End Phase, but it cannot attack directly this turn.

Common.name: Into the Darkness Below
Common.desc:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per turn, you can discard 1 Normal Fiend Monster, then use 1 of the following Skills.
● Draw 1 card, also flip this card over.
● If you have 4 or more Fiend Normal Monsters with different names in your GY, add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand, also flip this card over.

Common.name: Lady Assailant of Flames
Common.desc: FLIP: Banish the top 3 cards of your Deck; inflict 800 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Lancer Archfiend
Common.desc: Once per turn, when your monster declares an attack on your opponent's Defense Position monster: You can activate this effect; during that battle, if that monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Lava Golem
Common.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) to your opponent's field by Tributing 2 monsters they control. You cannot Normal Summon/Set the turn you Special Summon this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

Common.name: Legendary Fiend
Common.desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: This card gains 700 ATK.

Common.name: Lesser Fiend
Common.desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
Banish any monster destroyed by battle with this card.

Common.name: Level Up!
Common.desc: Send 1 face-up "LV" monster you control to the GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck that is listed in the sent monster's text, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

Common.name: Mad Reloader
Common.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, and if you do, draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Mask of Darkness
Common.desc: FLIP: Target 1 Trap in your GY; add that target to your hand.

Common.name: Mefist the Infernal General
Common.desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Make your opponent discard 1 random card.

Common.name: Melchid the Four-Face Beast
Common.desc: This monster has four different masks for four different attacks.

Common.name: Metal Reflect Slime
Common.desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 0/DEF 3000). (This card is also still a Trap.) This card cannot attack.

Common.name: Neck Hunter
Common.desc: A fiend that wields a mean sickle and fires devastating beams from its eyes.

Common.name: Newdoria
Common.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Nightmare Wheel
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent. That monster must be on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

Common.name: Offerings to the Doomed
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target, also skip your next Draw Phase.

Common.name: Prideful Roar
Common.desc: During damage calculation, if your monster battles an opponent's monster with a higher ATK: Pay LP equal to the difference in ATK; your monster gains ATK equal to that difference +300, during damage calculation only.

Common.name: Prometheus, King of the Shadows
Common.desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Banish 1 or more DARK monsters from your GY, and if you do, this card gains 400 ATK for each, until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Puppet Master
Common.desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can pay 2000 LP, then target 2 Fiend monsters in your GY; Special Summon those targets, but they cannot attack this turn.

Common.name: Rope of Life
Common.desc: When a monster(s) is destroyed by battle and sent to your GY: Discard your entire hand (min.1), then target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon it, and if you do, it gains 800 ATK.

Common.name: Shadow Reborn
Common.desc:
[Flip this card over when you activate this Skill.]

Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Once per Duel, you can pay half your LP and Special Summon 1 monster from either GY, but your opponent takes no battle damage this turn.

Common.name: Supply Squad
Common.desc: Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: Draw 1 card.

Common.name: Sword of Dark Destruction
Common.desc: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK and loses 200 DEF.

Common.name: That Which Feeds on Life
Common.desc: A monster that feeds on the energy of other creatures.

Common.name: The Earl of Demise
Common.desc: This gentlemanly creature is extremely wicked, feared by man and fiend alike.

Common.name: The Forceful Checkpoint
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Look at your opponent's hand, and if there is a Monster Card, negate the attack, then discard 1 monster from their hand (your choice).

Common.name: The Gross Ghost of Fled Dreams
Common.desc: This monster feeds on the dreams of an unwary sleeper, dragging the victim into eternal slumber.

Common.name: The Shadow Who Controls the Dark
Common.desc: A shadow that dwells in the dark, paralyzing its opponents and rendering them harmless.

Common.name: Tribute to the Doomed
Common.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

Common.name: Twin-Headed Wolf
Common.desc: While you control another Fiend monster, negate the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

Common.name: Twisted Personality
Common.desc:
[At the start of the Duel, flip this card over.]

Each time a player loses LP, place 1 counter on this card (max. 3). Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can use 1 of the following Skills.
● Remove 2 counters from this card, then discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand.
● Remove 3 counters from this card, then destroy 1 face-up card your opponent controls.

Common.name: Twister
Common.desc: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Veil of Darkness
Common.desc: During your Draw Phase, if you draw a DARK monster(s): You can reveal any number of them; send them to the GY, then you can draw 1 more card.

Common.name: Viser Des
Common.desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; during your third Standby Phase after this effect's activation, destroy that monster. This card cannot be destroyed by battle while the targeted monster is on the field.

Common.name: Whiptail Crow
Common.desc: Attacks from the skies with a whip-like tail.

Common.name: Yaiba Robo
Common.desc: A cubical machine equipped with cutting blades for shredding an opponent to mincemeat.

Common.name: Zoma the Spirit
Common.desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Zombie/DARK/Level 4/ATK 1800/DEF 500). (This card is also still a Trap.) If this card Summoned this way is destroyed by battle: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to the ATK of the monster that destroyed it.

Ultra Rare.name: Magical Stone Excavation
Ultra Rare.desc: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

Ultra Rare.name: Santa Claws
Ultra Rare.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) to your opponent's field in Defense Position, by Tributing 1 monster they control. If Summoned this way, once, during the End Phase of this turn: You can draw 1 card.
